h1: Courtyard by Marriott Suvarnabhumi — a brand-new 4-star with free 24-hour shuttle just 3 km from the airport
intro: If you want a reliable, brand-name hotel close to Suvarnabhumi Airport — not the priciest option in the terminal, not a tired property that opened ten years ago — Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport opened in late 2023 and fills exactly that gap. It sits on Lat Krabang Road, approximately 3 kilometres and around 8 minutes by car from Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK), and operates a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle in both directions (advance reservation required). The nearest ARL station, Lat Krabang, is around 4.4 km away and gives you a rail connection into central Bangkok when you need it. The hotel has 468 rooms and 14 suites, an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness centre, a spa with Thai massage, and four dining outlets including an international breakfast buffet and a burger bar by the pool. Rates run from around THB 4,500–5,500/night in the regular season and tick higher during peak periods. It scores 9.1 out of 10 from 1,414 verified guests on Booking.com and 9.4 from 879 reviews on Trip.com — numbers well above the airport-hotel average and a fair reflection of what real guests report.

body.html: The single biggest advantage here is that this hotel is new. Courtyard by Marriott Suvarnabhumi opened in late 2023, which means every room, every corridor, and every piece of furniture has had at most two or three years of wear. Guest reviews across Booking.com and Trip.com return to this point again and again: rooms feel genuinely fresh, beds have not yet acquired that slightly tired compression of older airport properties, and the plumbing works. The cleanliness score of 9.5 out of 10 on Booking.com is not marketing — it is real guests reporting what they found when they opened the door after a long flight.

Getting to and from the airport — the hotel's address is 599/9 Lat Krabang Road, Lat Krabang, Bangkok 10520. That puts it roughly 3 kilometres from Suvarnabhumi International Airport, or about 8 minutes by car in typical traffic conditions. The complimentary shuttle runs 24 hours a day in both directions. You need to book it in advance by calling +66 2 780 3588 or emailing cy.bkkap.cc@courtyard.com with your flight details. A small but consistent note in guest reviews is that the early-morning outbound schedule is not always announced proactively — confirm your pick-up time with the front desk when you check in, rather than discovering ambiguity at 04:30. The nearest Airport Rail Link (ARL) station, Lat Krabang, is approximately 4.4 km from the hotel and can take you into Makkasan or Phaya Thai in around 25 minutes.
"Arrived at midnight, shuttle was waiting at Arrivals. Room was spotlessly clean and felt brand new. Best airport hotel stay I've had in Bangkok — and the price was fair for what you get."

Rooms and what to expect inside — The 468 rooms divide into Superior (29 sq m) and Deluxe (29 sq m) categories, some with private balconies, some with garden access, and some with two double beds for families or travellers who need the extra width. The 14 suites step up to 59–69 square metres with a separate living area and a corner balcony on the largest configuration. Guests consistently praise the bedding quality, the powerful air conditioning, and the soundproofing, which manages the background noise of Lat Krabang Road well. The honest counterpoint from a handful of reviews is that some rooms face the car park or loading areas rather than anything scenic — mentioning a garden-view or pool-adjacent preference at check-in is worth the thirty-second conversation.

Facilities and dining — the hotel's four dining outlets cover most scenarios without needing to leave the property. Chon Som serves an international breakfast buffet that draws consistent praise in real reviews for variety and quality at the price — if breakfast is included in your rate, it is genuinely worth eating. The Lobby Deli handles grab-and-go coffee and pastries. Big Bite Burger is a dedicated burger bar positioned beside the pool for evenings. The Pool Bar completes the picture. Beyond dining, there is an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness centre, and a spa offering Thai massage and body treatments. The spa is not large, but for a transit stay the combination of pool and massage covers the bases most layover travellers actually want.

The honest weak points that appear in guest reviews are worth naming. The price is higher than most of the competition within a five-kilometre radius. Park Nine Hotel, roughly the same distance from the airport and also with a free shuttle, starts around THB 1,800/night — a meaningful difference if your budget is tight and you just need a clean bed. The Courtyard premium buys you the Marriott brand assurance, the freshness of a 2023-built property, and four dining venues instead of one or two. Whether that premium is worth it is a personal call. A second consistent note is that check-in can be slow during peak afternoon arrivals, so if you are arriving on an evening bank of flights, factor in a wait. Finally, the surrounding Lat Krabang neighbourhood has very little to offer sightseeing-wise — this is an industrial and residential district with no BTS access and limited walkable attractions.

Taken as a whole, the Courtyard by Marriott Suvarnabhumi earns its strong scores. A score of 9.1 from more than 1,400 real guests on Booking.com and 9.4 from nearly 900 on Trip.com is not a lucky run of reviews — it reflects a property that delivers on its core promise: a new, clean, well-staffed hotel with a reliable free shuttle to one of Asia's busiest airports. If that is what you need, this is one of the most consistently rated options in the Suvarnabhumi corridor. If your priority is value, there are cheaper options nearby. If your priority is using Bangkok as a sightseeing base, look at Sukhumvit or Silom instead.

honestSummary: Courtyard by Marriott Suvarnabhumi is the newest and most consistently reviewed 4-star hotel in the Suvarnabhumi corridor — fresh rooms, reliable free shuttle, strong staff scores, and an excellent breakfast buffet. The trade-off is a price premium over nearby competitors and a location that suits transit travellers far better than city explorers.
honestChecks: If your budget is tight and the brand name does not matter — Park Nine Hotel is around the same distance from the airport, also has a free shuttle, and starts at roughly THB 1,800/night. Book the Courtyard when the Marriott brand standard and the 2023-built freshness are worth paying for.

If you have a very early outbound flight — confirm your shuttle pick-up time at the front desk when you check in the evening before. A few guests mention that the early-morning schedule is not announced automatically, and discovering the ambiguity at 04:30 is not a pleasant experience.

If you want to explore Bangkok properly — Lat Krabang is an industrial district with no walkable attractions and no BTS access. The ARL at Lat Krabang station is ~4.4 km away. This hotel is purpose-built for transit; choose Sukhumvit or Silom if sightseeing is the priority.

tips.title: Book the shuttle in advance
tips.body: The free shuttle must be reserved ahead of time by calling +66 2 780 3588 or emailing cy.bkkap.cc@courtyard.com with your flight details. Also confirm the outbound pick-up time with the front desk on the evening before departure.

tips.title: Use ARL Lat Krabang for the city
tips.body: Lat Krabang ARL station is about 4.4 km from the hotel. Ask the hotel for a ride to the station — from there you can reach Makkasan or Phaya Thai in around 25 minutes and connect to the BTS Skytrain for central Bangkok.

tips.title: Do not skip the breakfast buffet
tips.body: The Chon Som international buffet is one of the most praised parts of the stay in real guest reviews. If breakfast is included in your rate, it is worth setting the alarm 30 minutes earlier to make the most of it.

tips.title: Use the pool before an evening flight
tips.body: If your departure is in the evening or at night, the outdoor pool and the Big Bite Burger bar beside it make a solid way to spend the afternoon. Far more relaxing than waiting in the terminal.

faqTitle: FAQ — Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport

faq.q: Does Courtyard Marriott Suvarnabhumi have a free airport shuttle? How do I book it?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel runs a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle in both directions between the property and Suvarnabhumi Airport, approximately 3 km / 8 minutes away. You must book in advance by calling +66 2 780 3588 or emailing cy.bkkap.cc@courtyard.com with your flight details. Confirm your outbound pick-up time at the front desk on the night before departure.

faq.q: How far is Courtyard by Marriott Suvarnabhumi from the airport?
faq.a: The hotel is approximately 3 kilometres from Suvarnabhumi International Airport (BKK), or about 8 minutes by car in normal traffic. The hotel address is 599/9 Lat Krabang Road, Lat Krabang, Bangkok 10520. The nearest Airport Rail Link (ARL) station — Lat Krabang — is around 4.4 km from the hotel.

faq.q: What are the room types and starting prices?
faq.a: Rooms are 29 sq m and come in Superior and Deluxe configurations — some with balconies, some with garden views, and some with two double beds for pairs or families. Suites step up to 59–69 sq m. Rates start from around THB 4,500–5,500/night for a Superior room in the regular season, rising during peak periods. Compare current rates across Booking.com, Agoda, and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for transit passengers, early-flight travellers, and late-night arrivals who want a brand-name hotel with a reliable free shuttle and consistent quality standards. It is not a good fit for guests who want to use Bangkok as a sightseeing base — Lat Krabang has no walkable attractions, no BTS access, and the ARL station is 4.4 km away.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a pool, gym, and restaurant?
faq.a: Yes to all three. The hotel has an outdoor pool (complimentary), a 24-hour fitness centre, a spa with Thai massage, and four dining venues: Chon Som international buffet restaurant (praised consistently in real reviews), The Lobby Deli, Big Bite Burger bar, and the Pool Bar.

faq.q: How does the Courtyard compare to Park Nine or Sinsuvarn nearby?
faq.a: The Courtyard is the newest and most expensive of the three, having opened in 2023 with Marriott brand standards. Park Nine Hotel is also ~3 km from the airport with a free shuttle and starts around THB 1,800/night — roughly THB 2,500–3,000 less. Sinsuvarn Airport Suite is the most affordable, starting around THB 900/night with a free 24-hr shuttle. Choose based on your budget and how much the brand assurance matters to you.
